Callout.Name: Farm Machinery Injury
Callout.Message: Person injured by a tractor, arm trapped.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, arm trapped, machine switched off.

Script.Line: It was the power take-off. It caught the sleeve and it pulled.
Do not touch the tractor. It is still in gear.
Nobody switches it off except me. That is the rule on this farm.

Callout.Patient: Do not move it. Whatever you do, do not move it.

Lines.Approach: Their arm is in it and the machine is off, and now it is a question of getting them free without making it worse.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
